INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors Shaman build

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Shaman’s Chain Lightning scales with dense waves, but Shaman ranks lowest in raw-damage breakdowns and is the most source-dependent class in this list. Treat its C-tier placement as a comparison of reported damage, not a promise that every run will be weak. Commit to the chain-damage plan and judge it against the wave in front of you.

Build phases

0–3 min

Take Chain Lightning when offered; otherwise establish another area tool before the first boss.

3–8 min

Commit to Chain Lightning as the carry and one survival tool. Keep moving as the wave becomes denser.

8–15 min

Rank up the carry, then cooldown reduction. Do not expect dense-wave scaling to solve every single-target boss.

Boss notes

Keep an exit available and use burst openings. A wave-clearing chain plan still needs disciplined movement against an isolated boss.

Common mistakes

Reading one damage ranking as a guarantee. Skipping early area coverage. Adding several support cards before committing carry ranks.

Skill priority

  • Chain Lightning or early area coverage.
  • Chain Lightning carry ranks.
  • One survival tool.
  • Cooldown reduction.

Passive priority

  1. Blessing of Might — +10% all damage per rank, +50% at rank 5. It helps every build; take it first.
  2. Arcane Intellect — 8% faster recharge per rank, 40% at rank 5, total capped at 65%.
  3. Amplify Magic — +10% area size per rank, +50% at rank 5. Huge for Flamestrike, Consecration, Volley.
  4. Blessing of Wisdom — +8% experience per rank, +40% at rank 5. Take it early or not at all.
  5. Power Word: Fortitude — +20% max health per rank, +100% at rank 5. Buffer on squishier classes.
  • See the full passive priority and stat caps

FAQ

Is Shaman a good first-clear choice?

Read the Shaman trade-off above and the tier list. Warrior or Paladin remains the forgiving first-clear starting point.

What should I take in the first three minutes?

Take Chain Lightning when offered; otherwise establish another area tool before the first boss.

When should I spend rerolls?

Use the level 6–12 commitment window, rather than spending rerolls in the first three levels.

What is the main Shaman mistake?

Reading one damage ranking as a guarantee. Skipping early area coverage. Adding several support cards before committing carry ranks.
